_about: Results that were measured in one-off evaluations and are not stored in the run folders. Used by docs/make_result_charts.py. Everything else the charts show is read from runs/ and docs/accelerator_workload.csv.

accuracy_by_run._source: Final head, mAP50 at confidence >= 0.001 on the 40 test images of the first 200-image subset, which no run trained on. Measured 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-02.

train6_per_head._source: train6_bdd70k/last.pt on the 1,500-image test split of bdd70k, measured 2026-10-02. Precision and recall at confidence >= 0.5.

train6_per_class._source: train6_bdd70k/last.pt, final head, AP50 on the same 1,500 test images. Training boxes are the counts in the 65,000-image training split.

postprocess_speedup._source: Median time until each head's answer is ready, same model (train2) and same 40 images, GTX 1650, measured 2026-09-28 before and after post-processing was rewritten. Per head, post-processing went from about 13.6 ms to about 2.9 ms.
